Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

For more than 25 years, Trakka has delivered innovative technologies including advanced gyro-stabilized imaging systems, EO/IR sensor platforms, high-intensity searchlights, mission management and mapping software, counter-UAS solutions, and integrated surveillance systems that support defense, law enforcement, border security, search and rescue, utility, and special mission operators around the world. Trakka Systems is a member of the Acron Technologies platform of specialized companies that innovate to create safer skies and protect lives. Trakka Systems is seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Drafter & Configuration Management Specialist to serve as the bridge between engineering design and controlled documentation. This role owns three interconnected responsibilities: producing and maintaining engineering drawings and 3D models in SolidWorks, driving the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) process from creation through approval, and managing the company's part number (PN) system. The ideal candidate combines strong technical drafting skills with the organizational discipline to keep product documentation accurate, released, and traceable. jobs.title: Senior Accounting Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Senior Accounting Specialist is responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the organization's financial records. This role performs complex accounting tasks, including, journal entries, account reconciliations, month-end and year-end close processes, and may support ad hoc financial analysis and special projects. The Senior Accounting Specialist ensures compliance with GAAP and internal policies, supports audits, and may assist in budgeting and forecasting activities. This position collaborates cross-functionally with other departments to support overall financial health and decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Program Management
jobs.description_text: The Acron Global Operations Team vision is to relentlessly reimagine and reshape the value chains by which we deliver results to our customers, suppliers, and internal/external stakeholder communities in pursuit of creating safer skies. The Opeartional Excellence (OP Ex) Sr. Program Manager is responsible to collaborate across Acron Business Unit (BU) and Product Line (PL) teams to develop strategies and actionable project plans in relentless pursuit of lean and continous improvement objectives. This role is crucial in building upon and positively fostering a Lean and Continuous Improvement culture. Global Operations Teams will earn the respect, trust, and collaboration of the Acron organization through inspirational leadership qualities essential to the realization of our vision. Our leadership, centered on motivating teams and individuals to deliver levels of performance perceived as unachievable, will shape culture, instill values, innovate, and continuously improve upon existing business methods to create value. We exemplify passion, courage, teamwork, ingenuity, ownership, efficiency, and candor in all that we do to delight our customers, suppliers and stakeholders. This position is part of the Acron HQ Global Operations Team and will be located in Grand Rapids, MI. The position will be on-site and require up to 25% travel to the multiple Acron business unit locations, both domestic and international.

jobs.title: Working Team Lead, Shipping
jobs.description_text: At Acron our ambition is to relentlessly reimagine and reshape the value chains by which we deliver results to our customers, suppliers, and internal/external stakeholder communities in pursuit of innovations to creating safer skies. Acron employees strive to achieve world-class results through our values of always putting our customers first, displaying ownership of our results, moving fast and speaking candidly. We currently seek a Working Team Lead, Shipping who thrives in a hands-on manufacturing environment and is highly skilled in daily execution, team leadership, problem solving, and continuous improvement. This position is part of the Acron Avionics Business Unit and will be located in Grand Rapids, MI. The role requires the selected candidate to work on site during first shift hours. The Working Team Lead is a front-line leadership role responsible for supporting daily operations, team performance, schedule execution, and issue escalation within the value stream. This position is expected to spend approximately 60% of time performing assembly/technician work and 40% of time performing leadership, administrative and continuous improvement responsibilities. The Working Lead serves as the primary liaison between operations employees and the Value Stream Leader (VSL), ensuring that the daily operations plan is executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with established standards.

jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient.

Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, Alabama & Mississippi Gulf Coast
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in person approximately once per month to each account for 1-3 days, often as day trips (supporting accounts in Montana and Utah). jobs.title: Growth Development Representative
jobs.description_text: The Growth Development Representative (GDR) drives Aledade's cohort-driven 1:many demand motion at the account level for Core accounts. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Compliance (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Business Compliance Manager drives Aledade’s operational compliance strategy, safeguarding the organization through robust vendor risk governance and regulatory alignment. Reporting collaboratively to Business and Corporate Compliance Leadership, this role primarily spearheads Aledade’s Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—mitigating vendor risk across the contract lifecycle. Additionally, the Manager serves as the primary liaison for external audits, acts as the Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business policies and SOPs, and fosters an ethical, compliant culture across all business units. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Aledade offers the following comprehensive total rewards package designed for the overall well-being of our team members: Base salary range: $111,000 – $150,000 USD annually The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. Where an individual offer lands within the range depends on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and internal equity. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.

jobs.title: Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement designs, improves, and documents the processes that run across the People Team, so that work is done once, done the same way, and done in the right place. Working with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Leave, and ADA, Employee Relations, Talent, Learning and Development, and the business partners, this role maps how work flows today, recommends what to automate, support with AI, redesign, or stop, and drives approved changes through to adoption. As the first process improvement hire, this role is the prerequisite to a longer-term automation roadmap for the People Team, which maps People Team work to automation, skill-building, AI agents, and eventually fully autonomous processes. It works from a prioritized improvement backlog set with People leadership, defines the service measures that show whether changes are working, and designs the shared services model, including the rotation that gives entry-level team members a path into other People Team roles. The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it. It is expected to use Aledade's approved AI tooling to speed up process mapping, documentation, and analysis, with human review of all output. The role needs to be excited to join a fast-paced startup with significant opportunity for growth and make a positive contribution to the healthcare field.

jobs.title: Network Development Sales Lead
jobs.description_text: As a Network Development Lead (NDL), you’ll drive Aledade’s growth by recruiting independent primary care practices into value-based care. You’ll be an empathetic, consultative expert who helps physicians understand how Aledade’s expertise, support, and technology can improve patient outcomes and practice sustainability. You’ll own an annual growth target in your core market. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to signed participation agreements. You’ll also partner with field teams and contribute to regional strategy.

jobs.title: Operations and AI Enablement Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Operations and AI Enablement Manager leads the Enterprise Performance enablement team and oversees the day-to-day operational needs of the practices it supports. This role manages a group of Enablement Specialists, setting their priorities, developing their skills, and holding the team accountable for the operating cadence, AI-enabled workflows, and project execution that drive value-based care performance. The Manager supports all Lines of Business (LOB) the team engages in, including Medicare Advantage, MSSP, Medicaid, and Commercial value-based care contracts. The Manager balances people leadership with hands-on operational ownership, resolving practice needs as they arise, removing blockers for the team, and translating executive priorities into repeatable systems that scale.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice (expected in the Florida panhandle). Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others.

Lead and drive Performance Excellence clinical outcomes across all Market contracts within your portfolio. Strategically align and coordinate with Market Leadership on Performance Excellence clinical drivers of shared savings aligned with the Aledade Annual Operating Plan, including but not limited to driving clinical performance in Risk and Hypertensive-based initiatives, while assisting in the launch of newly signed practices. In coordination with the Market ED, align on goals and objectives and deploy resources including but not limited to clinical coaching, and Aledade tools to drive successful clinical outcomes across the market. At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission. jobs.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, Remote
jobs.description_text: Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices. The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles. To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts. jobs.title: Senior Director, VBC Transformation, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Senior Director, VBC Transformation will lead cross-functional operational initiatives across Provider Networks to drive effective construction and deployment of the subject matter expert (SME) function in our Enterprise organization. This new SME function includes a group of specialized individuals that interface with account leadership to drive improvement in value-based care performance. This leadership role encompasses strategic oversight of the new SME function while managing day-to-day operations ensure that we achieve our profit and loss targets for the Enterprise market. The Senior Director will be responsible for deploying SMEs to accounts, delivering executive reporting, and cross-collaboration with departments within and outside of Provider Networks. The role requires strong leadership capabilities, VBC experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Accountant, Accounts Payable
jobs.description_text: The Staff Accountant of Accounts Payable owns day-to-day processing of non-PO invoices, including reaching out to vendors to confirm service periods and invoice details, coordinating with Finance Business Partners to confirm cost center and budget coding, and working with Accounting leadership to resolve coding questions in gray-area situations. This role also supports the P2P inbox, vendor onboarding and validation, vendor relationship ownership, and backs up expense report review. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly via email, thinks independently, and is comfortable using AI tools (such as Claude) to improve and automate AP processes. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

jobs.title: Sr. IT Support Manager

This role transcends daily task management to focus on high-level business ROI, annual strategic planning, and the design of robust, scalable support systems. The Sr. Manager acts as a mentor to others, an advocate for organizational growth, and a key partner to senior leadership in removing barriers to cross-departmental collaboration. They are the architect of the department’s culture, career paths, and vendor ecosystems.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Specialist, Payer Solutions
jobs.description_text: The Sr. Project Specialist drives strategic project execution, continuous improvement, and cross-functional alignment to optimize health plan performance and AI-enabled operations across multiple lines of business. This role is responsible for leading complex deliverables and establishing governance frameworks across multiple lines of business.

jobs.description_text: Our Company Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets. Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world. Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security. By combining asset ownership with advanced technologies and integration expertise, Energy Vault is building the next generation of critical energy infrastructure, delivering dependable power when and where it matters most. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Remote (US)
jobs.location_raw: Remote, USA: AL, AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, ME, MN, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.
